facts.fact: StackAdapt published the blog post 'Drive contextual advertising results with keyword rule targeting' on 15 August 2022.
StackAdapt states that advertisers get keyword-level reporting after running a Keyword Rule Targeting campaign.
facts.quote: After running your campaign, you have access to keyword-level reporting that you can analyze for actionable insights.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog says it highlights 4 benefits of keyword rule targeting that marketers should use.
facts.quote: Below, we’re highlighting 4 benefits that every marketer should take advantage of.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's example sore-throat campaign uses a first keyword set that includes throat, sore throat, cough, cold, common cold, runny nose, stuffy nose, and congested.
facts.value: throat, sore throat, cough, cold, common cold, runny nose, stuffy nose, congested
facts.quote: This might be to include web pages that match any of the keywords: throat, sore throat, scratchy throat, irritated throat, cough, cough drop, cold, common cold, cold season, runny nose, stuffy nose, nasal, nasal passage, congested.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's example uses a second keyword set focused on product positioning, including remedy, relief, temporary relief, soothe, and soothing, to narrow placements.
facts.value: remedy, remedies, relief, relieve, temporary relief, soothe, soothing
facts.quote: This will allow you to match your campaign with web pages that have these keywords: remedy, remedies, relief, relieve, temporary relief, soothe, soothing.

facts.fact: Keyword Rule Targeting lets advertisers exclude keywords, which StackAdapt says helps narrow context and ensure brand safety.
facts.quote: You’re also able to exclude keywords. This helps to narrow down to the nuances of the context you want for your ads, and it also helps ensure brand safety.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that its contextual keyword targeting lets advertisers target audiences without cookies or other user identifiers.
facts.quote: This contextual advertising tactic allows you to target audiences without the need for cookies or other user identifiers, and in a brand safe environment.
